content:
We're back to give you an update on what's new this week at the Apple Certified Refurbished store. This week's highlights include the MacBook Neo, new MacBook Air configurations, Apple Watch Ultra 3, and more.

The Apple Certified Refurbished store is a great way to save money, letting you buy products directly from Apple's official website and save up to 15%.

Here's what you need to know:

  • Outstanding quality, affordable prices
  • Undergoes a rigorous refurbishment process before being sold
  • Comes with Apple's one-year limited warranty
  • Covered by Apple's 14-day return policy
  • AppleCare products can be purchased additionally
  • Engraving and gift wrapping services are not available for refurbished products

We'll track every new addition and price drop at the Apple Certified Refurbished store so you don't have to monitor it yourself. Inventory changes quickly, and we hope this report helps you stay on top of stock availability so you can place your order while items are still available.

Mac computers

The MacBook Neo and MacBook Air prices remain my top recommended deals. Both are excellent choices for those joining the Apple ecosystem for the first time or upgrading to Apple Silicon.

MacBook Neo

  • MacBook Neo 256GB storage: $599 (originally $699)
  • MacBook Neo 512GB storage with Touch ID: $679 (originally $799)

MacBook Air

  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air with 512GB storage and 16GB memory: $1,099 (originally $1,299)
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air with 1TB storage and 16GB memory: $1,529 (originally $1,799)
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air with 2TB storage and 16GB memory: $1,949 (originally $2,299)

iMac

  • 24-inch M4 iMac with 256GB storage and 16GB memory: $1,269 (originally $1,499)
  • 24-inch M4 iMac with 512GB storage and 16GB memory: $1,439 (originally $1,699)

Studio Display

A few weeks ago we first reported that the Apple Refurbished store had the Studio Display XDR in stock. As always, a reminder that inventory can change quickly, and the Studio Display XDR is no exception. As of today, only two configurations remain available:

  • Studio Display XDR with standard glass and tilt- and height-adjustable stand: $2,799 (originally $3,299)
  • Studio Display XDR with nano-texture glass and tilt- and height-adjustable stand: $3,059 (originally $3,599)

Apple TV 4K

The long-awaited base model Apple TV 4K is back in stock this week, along with the higher-end version with Ethernet connectivity that has been consistently available. The base model typically sells out quickly, so don't wait if you want one.

  • Apple TV 4K (3rd generation) 64GB storage, Wi-Fi: $169 (originally $199)
  • Apple TV 4K (3rd generation) 128GB storage, Wi-Fi + Ethernet: $209 (originally $249)

Apple Watch Ultra

I wear the Apple Watch Ultra 3 every day, and if you'd like to get one too, the Apple Refurbished store has some great deals this week:

  • Apple Watch Ultra 3 (GPS + Cellular), 49mm Black Titanium case with Black Ocean band: $679 (originally $799)
  • Apple Watch Ultra 3 (GPS + Cellular), 49mm Natural Titanium case with Anchor Blue Ocean band: $679 (originally $799)

As always, the latest Apple deals throughout the week can be found at 9to5Toys.
